_provenance: Design Laws 1+3+4 stated as physics. NPCs are wordless, embodied, and remember.

walls.response_diversity: Every role must use multiple gestures. A single-response NPC is a vending machine, not a character.
walls.pirate_aggression_measured: Pirates MUST threaten. Design Law 3 (wordless) — aggression is the pirate's only language.
walls.engagement_rate: NPCs must respond when approached. A world of NPCs that ignore you is a world that doesn't care.
